tasks.name: ckm_matrix_element_v_ud
tasks.description: Cabibbo-Kobayashi-Maskawa quark mixing matrix element connecting up and down quarks. Governs beta decay rates and reflects the geometry of flavor space. Physical context: The CKM matrix describes quark flavor mixing in weak interactions. V_ud is the largest element, close to unity, suggesting a near-diagonal structure. Z² hint: The value 0.97373 is close to cos(θ_C) where θ_C is the Cabibbo angle. May relate to geometric angle in flavor space.

tasks.name: ckm_matrix_element_v_us
tasks.description: CKM matrix element for up-strange quark mixing. Also known as the Cabibbo angle sine: sin(θ_C) ≈ 0.225. Physical context: Controls the rate of strangeness-changing weak decays like K → πlν. The Cabibbo angle θ_C ≈ 13° defines this mixing. Z² hint: sin(θ_C) ≈ 0.225 might relate to a fundamental geometric angle. Consider 3/13 ≈ 0.231 connection.

tasks.name: ckm_matrix_element_v_cb
tasks.description: CKM matrix element for charm-bottom quark mixing. Much smaller than V_ud, indicating hierarchical structure. Physical context: Governs b → c transitions. The small value reflects the mass hierarchy between quark generations. Z² hint: V_cb ≈ 0.042 might be related to 1/Z or 1/Z² expressions where Z = √(32π/3).

tasks.name: ckm_matrix_element_v_ub
tasks.description: CKM matrix element for up-bottom quark mixing. Smallest element, crucial for CP violation. Physical context: Enables b → u transitions and direct CP violation. Ratio V_ub/V_cb ≈ 0.09 is a key observable. Z² hint: The ratio V_ub/V_cb might have geometric significance in flavor space.

tasks.name: jarlskog_invariant_j
tasks.description: Rephasing-invariant measure of CP violation in the quark sector. Determines matter-antimatter asymmetry from CKM. Physical context: J = Im(V_ud V_cb* V_ub* V_cd) is the unique invariant measuring CP violation. Maximum possible value is 1/(6√3) ≈ 0.096. Z² hint: J/J_max ≈ 3.3×10^-4 might relate to Z² geometric suppression factors.

tasks.name: cp_violation_phase_δ_ckm
tasks.description: CP-violating phase in the CKM matrix, approximately 66 degrees. Source of quark sector CP violation. Physical context: The phase δ appears in the standard CKM parameterization. Non-zero δ is required for CP violation. Z² hint: δ ≈ 66° might relate to arccos(Z-related fraction) or arctan expressions.

tasks.name: pmns_matrix_element_sin²θ_12

tasks.name: pmns_matrix_element_sin²θ_23
tasks.description: Atmospheric neutrino mixing angle. Near-maximal mixing governs ν_μ ↔ ν_τ oscillations. Physical context: θ_23 ≈ 47° is close to 45° (maximal mixing). Atmospheric neutrino anomaly provides the measurement. Z² hint: Near-maximal mixing suggests geometric origin. sin²θ_23 ≈ 1/2 might be exact in some limit.

tasks.name: pmns_matrix_element_sin²θ_13
tasks.description: Reactor neutrino mixing angle. Smallest PMNS mixing parameter, enables leptonic CP violation. Physical context: θ_13 ≈ 8.5° was measured in 2012 by Daya Bay. Non-zero value opens door to leptonic CP violation. Z² hint: sin²θ_13 ≈ 0.022 might relate to (2Z - 3°)² or similar Z-dependent angle formula.

tasks.name: neutrino_mass_squared_difference_δm²_21
tasks.description: Solar mass squared splitting in eV². Determines solar neutrino oscillation frequency. Physical context: Δm²_21 = m²_2 - m²_1 ≈ 7.5×10^-5 eV² governs the MSW effect in the Sun. Z² hint: The ratio Δm²_21/Δm²_31 ≈ 0.03 might have Z² geometric significance.

tasks.name: top_quark_mass

tasks.name: w_boson_mass

tasks.name: z_boson_width

tasks.name: higgs_boson_mass
tasks.description: Mass of the Higgs boson in GeV. Discovered at LHC in 2012. Physical context: M_H = √(2λ)·v where λ is Higgs self-coupling and v = 246 GeV. This implies λ ≈ 0.129. Z² hint: M_H ≈ 125.2 GeV. Ratio M_H/v ≈ 0.509 might relate to 1/2 or Z²-derived value.

tasks.name: strong_coupling_at_m_z
tasks.description: QCD coupling constant α_s evaluated at the Z pole mass. Physical context: α_s(M_Z) determines the strength of strong interactions at electroweak scale. Running gives α_s(1 GeV) ≈ 0.5. Z² hint: α_s ≈ 0.118 is very close to 4/Z² ≈ 0.1194. Strong candidate for Z² derivation.

tasks.name: pion_decay_constant_f_π
tasks.description: Weak decay constant of the charged pion in MeV. Defines chiral symmetry breaking scale. Physical context: f_π parameterizes ⟨0|A_μ|π⟩. Related to quark condensate and chiral perturbation theory. Z² hint: f_π ≈ 92 MeV. Ratio f_π/Λ_QCD or f_π/m_π ≈ 0.66 might have significance.

tasks.name: neutron_proton_mass_difference

tasks.name: proton_charge_radius

tasks.description: Anomalous magnetic moment a_e = (g-2)/2 of the electron. Most precise QED test. Physical context: a_e = α/(2π) - 0.328(α/π)² + ... Determines the fine structure constant. Z² hint: a_e ≈ α/(2π). The deviation from this leading term might show Z² structure.

tasks.name: fermi_coupling_constant
tasks.description: Fermi constant G_F in GeV^-2. Strength of weak interactions at low energy. Physical context: G_F = (√2/8) × g²/M_W² = 1/(√2 v²) where v is Higgs VEV. Z² hint: G_F × M_W² ≈ 0.0375 might relate to Z² geometric factors.

tasks.name: planck_mass
tasks.description: Planck mass M_P = √(ℏc/G) in GeV. Scale where quantum gravity becomes strong. Physical context: M_P sets the hierarchy problem: why is M_H << M_P? Ratio M_P/M_W ≈ 10^17. Z² hint: M_P/M_W ≈ 1.5×10^17. The logarithm ln(M_P/M_W) ≈ 39.5 might relate to Z² expressions.

tasks.name: cosmological_constant_density

tasks.name: matter_density_parameter
tasks.description: Total matter density Ω_m = Ω_b + Ω_c. Includes baryons and cold dark matter. Physical context: Ω_m ≈ 0.315 with Ω_b ≈ 0.049 baryonic. CDM dominates by factor of 5. Z² hint: Ω_m = 6/19 ≈ 0.3158 complements Ω_Λ = 13/19. Flat universe: Ω_m + Ω_Λ = 1.

tasks.name: scalar_amplitude_a_s

tasks.name: cmb_temperature_t_0

tasks.name: sound_horizon_at_recombination

tasks.name: baryon_photon_ratio_η

tasks.description: RMS matter fluctuation in 8 h^-1 Mpc spheres. Physical context: σ_8 measures clustering strength. Tension with weak lensing (σ_8 ≈ 0.76). Z² hint: σ_8 ≈ 0.811 or 30/37 ≈ 0.811 might be Z²-derived.

tasks.name: muonium_hyperfine_splitting
